newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Yapi Kredi plans to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Turk Yapi Kredi plans to raise capital.

text.p: Yapi Kredi Bankasi, a leading Turkish bank, is planning to increase its capital to 60.07 trillion lira from 25.78 trillion, the Istanbul stock exchange said.

In a statement to the Exchange, the bank said the capital would be increased by issuing 15.467 trillion lira or 0.6 rights share for one existing share and 18.819 trillion lira or 0.73 bonus share for one existing share.
The capital increase will be in effect after the decision was approved by the general assembly on March 31. The increase will also be subject to the approval of the Capital Markets Board.
